sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:7

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:7:1
items.html: That there are no MAN whatsoever that are corrected at the first time: That is, as above: at the first time they rise in the discernments of the records included in the Katnut of the upper, in the discernment of MAN [Mayin Nukvin] to the upper of the upper, as in the adjacent item above — the records of the NRN [Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama] of the righteous are included in the Katnut of ZON in the discernment of MAN; and when ZON rise as MAN to AVI to attain the Mochin of Gadlut, they take with them the MAN of the NRN of the righteous, for before the coupling of the Gadlut of ZON, the AHP of ZON and the NRN of the righteous are one discernment, included one in the other. And it turns out that the coupling made upon these MAN in AVI is necessarily also made upon the NRN of the righteous, as upon the AHP of ZON, for they are included together; and nevertheless, this coupling corrects nothing for the NRN of the righteous, but only for the completion of the AHP and the Mochin of Gadlut for ZON, as said above: after this coupling, when the first discernment of the MAN — the AHP of ZON — has been clarified from them, ZON then descend with the second discernment, which remains still without any correction — the NRN of the righteous — to their place; and then the coupling is made upon them in the place of ZON, as above. Thus, these MAN of the NRN of the righteous received two couplings: the first in AVI, namely together with ZON, at the time when ZON received their Mochin of Gadlut; and the second within ZON below. From the first coupling in AVI, nothing was depicted from them, and nothing was corrected of them; only in the second coupling of ZON. And precisely this order is practiced in the MAN of all the Partzufim, in the manner explained above with ZON, with AVI, and with AA. And this is what he said: “there are no MAN whatsoever that are corrected at the first time; rather, at the first time they rise in the discernment of MAN, and afterwards, at the second coupling, they are corrected, and from them come out creatures and souls.” And understand well.
